calls.reasoning: A drawing of the command path is the clearest way to answer this. I'll sketch it and then add a short explanation.
calls.text:
Here's how a command flows through ledger-cli:

```sketch
title How a command runs
dir right
group cmds Commands
cli index.js @terminal !accent
add add @plus in cmds
list list @list in cmds
total total @sigma in cmds
parser parser.js @braces
ledger ledger.txt (cylinder)
cli -> add
cli -> list
cli -> total
add -> parser parse
parser -> ledger append
list --> ledger read
total --> ledger read
```

Every command goes through the same front door: `src/index.js` parses the arguments, picks a command module, and only `add` writes, appending through `parser.js`. `list` and `total` just read the plain-text ledger, which keeps the format easy to reason about.
